components.name: Execute / Save
components.description: Compact green primary action with the source hover, focus, and disabled states.
components.css: .ds-primary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:5px;min-height:28px;padding:4px 9px;border:1px solid #527d57;border-radius:4px;background:#344c38;color:#c9eccb;font:13px/1.5 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;cursor:pointer;}.ds-primary svg{width:15px;height:15px;fill:currentColor;stroke:none;}.ds-primary:hover:not(:disabled){background:#3b5c40;}.ds-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--blue, #88b4fa);outline-offset:-2px;}.ds-primary:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:default;}

components.name: Tool Button
components.description: Transparent named toolbar action with the shared outline SVG treatment.
components.css: .ds-tool{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;min-height:28px;padding:4px 7px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:4px;background:transparent;color:var(--text, #dfe1e5);font:13px/1.5 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;cursor:pointer;}.ds-tool svg{fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.4;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;flex-shrink:0;width:16px;height:16px;}.ds-tool:hover:not(:disabled){background:#393c43;}.ds-tool:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--blue, #88b4fa);outline-offset:-2px;}.ds-tool:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:default;}

narrative.overview:
The implemented world follows the user's pinned dark DataGrip New UI reference: graphite tool chrome, darker editing surfaces, restrained state colors, and compact controls. The interface gives database objects, SQL, and returned data a shared working frame. System UI text carries controls and navigation; monospace carries SQL, data, and measurements. There is no display type role.

Durable product commitments are the GridBase name, the dark IDE character, and keeping objects, SQL, and results within one working screen. This record describes `public/styles.css`, `public/index.html`, and the component and layout behavior in `public/app.js`. It records implementation evidence, not visual approval: the browser host was unavailable, desktop and mobile captures are missing, and the finish review requires recapture. Apparent legibility and responsive fit still need rendered verification; source values are not proof of that verification.
keyCharacteristics: Dense pane boundaries and aligned toolbars rather than spacious dashboard cards.
Blue selection and focus, green execution and connection success, coral errors.
Flat working surfaces with soft shadows reserved for floating layers.
Authored outline SVG icons and monospace SQL and data.

rules.name: The State Color Rule
rules.body: Blue identifies interaction; green identifies execution or connection success; coral identifies errors. Keep SQL syntax colors inside code.

rules.name: The Content Type Rule
rules.body: Use the UI stack for application controls and the monospace stack for SQL, returned values, and measurements. Preserve matching editor and gutter metrics.

rules.name: The Working Plane Rule
rules.body: Keep the explorer, editor, and grid flat. Reserve soft, offset shadows for the implemented floating layers.

dos: Do keep persistent working areas edge-aligned, compact, and separated by tone and thin rules.
Do preserve the State Color Rule and keep syntax colors associated with SQL roles.
Do keep SQL and gutter metrics identical and reserve monospace for SQL, data, and measurements.
Do include visible keyboard focus and pair connection or query state colors with text.
Do preserve pane-level scrolling, truncation with access to full content, and the overlay behavior at narrow widths.
donts: Don't replace the confirmed dark IDE world with a spacious card dashboard.
Don't add decorative shadows to persistent explorer, editor, or results panes.
Don't introduce a display type voice into the compact application hierarchy.
Don't replace the consistent SVG icon system with text glyphs or proprietary branding assets.
Don't treat source inspection or synthetic controller tests as rendered design approval; capture desktop and mobile before claiming visual fit.
